text:
tess: quick sync - proposing a 'quota-aware unified-envelope' approach: one ingress envelope with tenant_shard + billing_token + sample_hint, and a router that can circuit to a low-cost degraded path when tenant quota is exceeded. goal: reduce parser duplication and handle noisy tenants without lane splits. thoughts? :thinking:
omar: interesting. two things: 1) how do we ensure billing determinism when we potentially circuit to degraded path? 2) how do queries that expect attributes inline behave?
tess: good Qs. billing determinism: we mandate billing_token in the fast header for any tenant that requires chargeback accuracy. Router resolves token -> billing_key synchronously (cheap cache/lookup). If resolution fails, envelope gets flagged for quarantine and retried.
brad: about degraded path: what does it mean? drop enrichment? sample more aggressively? We need a clear semantics set.
tess: degraded path options we discussed: A) sample and drop high-card attributes, B) store body_ref + checksum and materialize attrs lazily, C) route to a lower-cost cluster with eventual consistency. Router policy decides per-tenant.
nina: plus tracing: make sure trace_id is present in the header and preserved across degraded materialization so stitcher can join events. Also include span_hint when possible to reduce ambiguity for reconstruction.
omar: retention semantics are tricky. Historically lanes implied TTLs. We should expose a retention_tag on the header (short|standard|long) so storage honors tenant contracts even if routed to degraded path.
tess: agreed. header sketch I dropped in the draft RFC: ```json
{"hdr_v": "1","fast": {"trace_id": "t_9abc","billing_token": "btok_77","tenant_shard": "shard-12","arrival_ts": 1710000000},"policy": {"retention": "long","sample_hint": false,"quota_mode": "standard"},"ref": {"body_ref": "s3://raw/2026/part-0001.avro","checksum": "sha256:..."}}
```
brad: we should also add a quota_key to the header to support deterministic quota checks downstream (e.g., per-customer vs per-subtenant). Router can use a fast in-memory consistent hash to pick a shard and decrement local counters. If counters exceeded, apply the tenant's configured degraded_policy.
nina: replay/backfill: materializers must be idempotent and use checksum+format_v to detect duplicates. If a late materialization happens after billing window closed, materializer should write a bill_snapshot record instead of altering past invoices.
omar: metrics and alerting: watch billing_latency_p50/p95, degraded_rate_by_tenant, parser_cpu_ms_p50, attr_cardinality_delta, join-index-miss-rate. Set burn thresholds: degraded_rate > 5% for top-20 tenants -> pager.
tess: operational rollout plan: 1) accept unified envelopes in parallel with existing lanes; 2) enable quota-aware router for a small cohort of medium-volume tenants (5% traffic); 3) verify billing latency, degraded_rate, and query compatibility; 4) expand cohorts; 5) flip for remaining tenants. Rollback by switching router policy per cohort. Owner: @tess. Rollback window: 1h for cohort stage, 3h for billing stage.
brad: could we add a deterministic sampling hash to header (sample_hash) so sampling is stable across retries and backfills? That helps cost reconciliation.
tess: yes - will add sample_hash + sample_version. Also will add policy flags: force_full_ingest, allow_degraded_materialization.
ops-bot: created ticket infra/obs/quota-aware-envelope-4476543210. bench queued: https://ci.redwood/obs/bench/4476543210. ETA 36h.
nina: sidecar note: ensure sidecars inject trace_id and sample_hash if missing. Stitcher will consume fast header + materialized attrs and emit a single unified trace. I'll prototype a stitcher that supports checksum-based dedupe.
omar: query compatibility: propose a compact join-index mapping body_ref -> enriched_attrs that lives in a small low-latency store. Queries can join on body_ref. Index TTL aligns with retention_tag. This avoids pulling full payloads into the main pipeline.
brad: action items: tess update RFC with header schema (hdr_v+fast+policy+ref), quota_key semantics, degraded_policies enum, sample_hash rules, and migration checklist. nina prototype stitcher & join-index; omar validate SLO deltas & alert thresholds; infra to run perf and quota bench.
tess: thanks all. tagging for 2pm sync on Friday. :white_check_mark:
